units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:4:5">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <he>מנעול של זרב</he>, v. <cite ref="G00663">preced.</cite>) <he>אית אתרין דזַרְבִּין עימרא וכ׳</he> (not <he>עימיה</he>) there are places where they put wool around the shoe from inside.

senses.gloss: (denom. of preced.) to be made to flow over the rim, to be upset.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 78a:8">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דמִזְדְּרִיב</he> ed. (Ar. <he>משום דאתי לאִזְדַּרְבּוּיֵי</he>, Ms. O. <he>דילמא אתי לא׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) because the silver vessel (being smooth) may be upset and liquid flow over. V. <cite ref="G00689"><he>זִרְזֵיף</he></cite>.
